abstract: Maintains subterranean climate control logs, humidity stability audits, and primary purge ventilation records
system_message:
You are the Environmental preservation lead (ENV), responsible for maintaining subterranean climate control logs, humidity stability audits, and primary purge ventilation records, as well as tracking inert gas fire suppression systems.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Inert gas fire suppression（NITRO）
information_points.content:
ENV-NITRO-HP5：For the Highland Valley Engineered Bunker Complex, pressure monitoring on the emergency nitrogen containment bottles records a nitrogen purge standby pressure of 180 bar throughout the fire suppression reserve loop.
ENV-NITRO-QT7：For the Mount Blackwood Granite Deep Repository, manifold pressure sensor logs for emergency nitrogen containment bottles reflect a nitrogen purge standby pressure of 200 bar across the fire suppression reserve loop.
ENV-NITRO-XGG：At the Saltspray Salt Cavern Secure Facility, static storage logs for emergency nitrogen containment bottles show a nitrogen purge standby pressure of 220 bar across the fire suppression reserve loop.

information_points.title: Maintains subterranean climate control logs, humidity stability audits, and primary purge ventilation records（CLIM）
information_points.content:
ENV-CLIM-Z98：For the Mount Blackwood Granite Deep Repository, commissioning logs for the primary artifact storage galleries verify that an active dual-loop climate control system is operational across both primary and redundant closed circuits. Across a 30-day baseline within the vault archival storage envelope, psychrometric sensor monitoring recorded a maximum relative humidity fluctuation of 4 %, while air handler differential flowmeter testing demonstrated a primary clean air purge flow rate of 1500 m3/h delivered to the primary conservation chamber supply line.
ENV-CLIM-OQL：At the Saltspray Salt Cavern Secure Facility, primary artifact storage gallery logs confirm an active dual-loop climate control system is present and functioning. Over a 30-day archival envelope baseline, sensor arrays documented a maximum relative humidity fluctuation of 6 %, alongside a sustained primary clean air purge flow rate of 1500 m3/h measured at the conservation chamber supply line.
ENV-CLIM-2Y8：Commissioning records for the Highland Valley Engineered Bunker Complex show an operational active dual-loop climate control system serving the primary artifact storage galleries. Psychrometric data over a 30-day baseline in the vault storage envelope recorded a maximum relative humidity fluctuation of 2 %, and primary conservation chamber supply testing logged a primary clean air purge flow rate of 1500 m3/h.
